| order by Timestamp desc

2562.sent:
let win = 30m;
let polluters = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where HttpMethod =~ "PATCH"
    | where Url has "@apostrophecms"
    | where Url has_any ("__proto__", "constructor", "prototype") or UrlOriginal has_any ("__proto__", "pullAll")
    | project PatchTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, PatchUrl = Url;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where HttpMethod =~ "GET"
| where Url has "/api/v1/@apostrophecms/user" or Url has "/api/v1/@apostrophecms/global"
| where toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)
| join kind=inner polluters on SrcIpAddr
| where TimeGenerated between (PatchTime .. PatchTime + win)
| project PatchTime, BypassTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, PatchTime), SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, PatchUrl, BypassUrl = Url
| sort by BypassTime desc
2562.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as patch_time from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=PATCH Web.url="*@apostrophecms*" (Web.url="*__proto__*" OR Web.uri_query="*__proto__*" OR Web.uri_query="*pullAll*") by Web.src Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| rename src as attacker_src dest as target_host
| join type=inner attacker_src target_host [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as bypass_time from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=GET (Web.url="*/api/v1/@apostrophecms/user*" OR Web.url="*/api/v1/@apostrophecms/global*") Web.status=200 by Web.src Web.dest
    | `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
    | rename src as attacker_src dest as target_host ]
| eval delay_sec = bypass_time - patch_time
| where delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec <= 1800
| convert ctime(patch_time) ctime(bypass_time)
| table attacker_src target_host patch_time bypass_time delay_sec
| sort - bypass_time

CloudAppEvents

2650.sent:
let lookback = 30d;

    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(lookback) .. ago(recent))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize by UserUpn = tolower(UserPrincipalName), IPAddress;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recent)
| where OperationName in ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User changed default security info","User registered all required security info","User started security info registration")
| where Result == "success"
| extend RegIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), UserUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))

| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
| rename object as user, src as reg_src
